summary: Iteration 16 backend-only. Added 6 new tests in test_tipo_admin_and_certs.py covering: (a) PUT /api/students/{admin_id} persists tipo_admin='lider'/'docente'/'ejecutivo'/'administrador' with X-User-Id header and verified via GET /api/bootstrap; (b) idempotent update lider->docente; (c) partial PUT without tipo_admin does NOT wipe the existing value (data.model_dump filters None via 'v is not None' in server.py:367); (d) every certificate returned by /api/bootstrap has non-empty string 'categoria' (prevents frontend toUpperCase crash). Regression: all 59 prior tests still green. Total 65/65 PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:367 uses data.model_dump() with post-filter 'v is not None' instead of model_dump(exclude_unset=True). Current behavior happens to be safe (None fields are dropped so partial PUT preserves), but the docstring/context in the review request mentions exclude_unset semantics. If in the future someone needs to intentionally CLEAR a field with null, this pattern will block it. Consider migrating to exclude_unset=True for explicit semantics.
ProfileUpdate lacks value validation for tipo_admin (accepts any string). Recommend Literal['lider','docente','ejecutivo','administrador'] or an Enum to reject typos server-side.
GET /api/bootstrap returns admin's own record in data['student'] but excludes admins from data['students']. That's correct; just noting for maintainers.
test_credentials: New admin accounts are created per-test via signup (admin.tipo.<hex>@tecmilenio.mx) since admin.demo@tecmilenio.mx is not seeded.
seed_data_creation: None (test users only, self-cleaning by unique email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. ProfileUpdate now includes tipo_admin (Optional[str]) alongside campus/certificado/intereses/semestre/carrera/descripcion/avatar/certificados_cursados. PUT /students/{id} filters None values before $set, so partial updates never wipe existing fields.
